类 Dtos

java.lang.Object
restserver.Dtos
public class Dtos extends Object
Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for the Battleship REST protocol. These are plain Java classes (POJOs). Spring Boot + Jackson automatically serialises them to/from JSON — no extra annotations needed for basic use. Kept in a single file so students have one place to read the full contract.

    m1b RESPONSE ← 200 OK (AI → student, result of student's shots) m2b RESPONSE ← 200 OK (student → AI, result of AI's shots) Example JSON: { "results": [ { "row": "B", "column": 3, "outcome": "MISS" }, { "row": "G", "column": 7, "outcome": "HIT", "shipType": "caravela" }, { "row": "D", "column": 10, "outcome": "SUNK", "shipType": "galeao" } ], "shipsRemaining": 8, "gameStatus": "ONGOING" } gameStatus values: "ONGOING" | "GAME_OVER" outcome values: "MISS" | "HIT" | "SUNK" | "REPEATED" | "INVALID"
